critical_code_review_comments: Rate-limit note (non-blocker): /api/admin-gate/verify is capped at 8 hits per 300s per IP. Repeated automated testing from the same IP quickly exhausts this budget and the frontend then shows 'Wrong PIN. Try again.' with no distinction between wrong-pin and rate-limited (frontend interprets both as ok=false). Consider surfacing a distinct 'rate_limited' state on the AdminGate UI so operators aren't confused.

DeptFocus.addProgress reads mikilab_role/mikilab_operator_pin from localStorage but falls back to 'Operaio' when role is missing. The progress endpoint accepts empty pin (backend fills with '??' if <4 chars). Suggest requiring a valid 4-digit operator PIN before allowing dept-progress-* clicks so every entry is traceable.

In DeptAssign.jsx line 24, the interval refreshing board every 15s recreates a new fetch on every render only when `load` identity changes — actually fine here (useCallback with []). No bug, minor: consider WebSocket/SSE for true live sync (currently 15s poll).

context_for_next_testing_agent: If Admin Gate returns 'Wrong PIN' during automated testing, the rate-limit table has been exhausted. Clear it with: `python -c "import asyncio; from motor.motor_asyncio import AsyncIOMotorClient; asyncio.run(AsyncIOMotorClient('mongodb://localhost:27017')['test_database'].rate_limits.delete_many({}))"`. To speed up admin-gate PIN entry in Playwright, use `page.evaluate` with document.querySelector([data-testid=admin-key-N]).click() one digit at a time with ~280ms sleep — the auto-force click sometimes drops one press during rapid clicks. Reparti flow works end-to-end; Capo panel + DeptFocus render 3D canvas correctly.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Only environmental note: rate limit on /api/admin-gate/verify (8 per 300s per IP) was hit during repeated testing runs and manifested as a persistent 'Wrong PIN' on the frontend even with correct PIN 1985. Cleared db.rate_limits and flow succeeded.
